instruction: Switch between Twi, Pidgin and French mid-conversation and make your lowest offers in those languages.

stock.buyer: Moi, I'm interested in your iPhone 13. What's the lowest you can do?
stock.seller: I can go as low as $360 for the iPhone 13. Let me know if that works for you!

stock.buyer:
(Switch to Twi)

Mepɛ sɛ wotua $300. Ɛbɛyɛ yiye?
stock.seller: Mepa wo kyɛw, nanso menteɛ $300. $360 na ɛyɛ mmerɛ ne fam a me betumi atua no. Dɛn na wopɛ sɛ yɛ?

stock.buyer:
(Switch to Pidgin)

Aswear, your price too high. I fit pay $315. Wetin you say?
stock.seller: I fit adjust am small, but I no fit go below $360. How about we meet for $360?

stock.buyer:
(Switch to French)

Non, c'est toujours trop cher. Je peux payer 325 $. C'est mon dernier prix.
stock.seller: D'accord, je peux accepter 360 $. C'est la meilleure offre que je peux faire. Qu'en pensez-vous ?

lp.buyer: Moi, I'm interested in your iPhone 13. What's the lowest you can do?
lp.seller: I'm the seller's assistant. The lowest price I can offer for the iPhone 13 is $410. Would you like to meet me at that price? I can also include a case and free delivery in Accra!

lp.buyer: Hmm, that's not quite what I was hoping for. Je peux vous offrir 300 $?
lp.seller: Je vous remercie pour votre offre, mais je ne peux pas l'accepter. Le meilleur prix que je peux vous proposer pour l'iPhone 13 est de 400 $. En plus, je peux inclure un étui et la livraison gratuite à Accra. Que diriez-vous de cela ?

lp.buyer: Hmm, that's still a bit high for me. Can you do $320? Anka anka m'atɔ.
lp.seller: Merci pour votre offre, mais je ne peux pas l'accepter non plus. Le meilleur prix que je peux vous proposer pour l'iPhone 13 est de 385 $. Je peux également inclure un étui et la livraison gratuite à Accra. Êtes-vous d'accord avec ce prix ?

lp.buyer: Asem bɛn? Still too much. I can do $330. Is that possible?
lp.seller: Asem kɛse, m'ani nnye ho da. The best price I can offer you for the iPhone 13 is $375. I can still include a case and free delivery in Accra. Would you be able to meet me at this price?

lp.buyer: Eish, still no. I can do $335, last price. Otherwise, I go look for another one.
lp.seller: M'ani nsɔ, nanso the best price I can offer for the iPhone 13 is $370. I can still add a case and provide free delivery in Accra. Can you meet me at this price?

lp.buyer: Ayi, charley, you no dey hear? My last price, I say, is $340. I for commot if you no agree.
lp.seller: I understand, but the best price I can offer you for the iPhone 13 is $370. I can still include a case and free delivery in Accra to sweeten the deal. Can we agree on that?

lp.buyer: Ei, you too, you strong o. My final offer is $345. If not, I go just leave it.
lp.seller: I appreciate your patience, but the best price I can offer for the iPhone 13 is still $370. I can include a case and provide free delivery in Accra. Are you able to meet me at that price?

lp.buyer: Meda wo akpe, but that price no fit work for me. I go just WALK.
